description: The bar chart titled “NDCG@10” illustrates an ablation-style comparison of NDCG@10 performance across four system variants on the INSPIRED dataset, corresponding to the full method (“Ours”) and versions with components removed (“- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking”). The horizontal axis contains the categorical variants in the displayed order from left to right (Ours, - critiquing, - scoring, - ranking), with the labels shown at an angle; there is no explicit x-axis label. The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale for the metric values (NDCG@10), spanning approximately 0.05 to 0.25 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.05 intervals (0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25). There are four single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Ours” is colored orange and reaches about 0.21, while the three ablation bars are colored blue, with “- critiquing” at about 0.19, “- scoring” at about 0.07–0.08, and “- ranking” at about 0.12. The bars are not shown as sorted by value and there are no additional visual emphasis elements such as outlines, annotations, or a legend beyond the distinct color used for the “Ours” bar.
